propositions: add_comment returns raw ACLI batch envelope {results, successCount, totalCount} instead of normalized comment resource, violating its declared return type and consumer expectations
the envelope's results[].id field contains a work-item key, not a comment-id, creating a trap for future consumers and enabling silent no-ops when no id is found
sibling methods (get_comments, create_issue, get_issue) normalize/verify payloads at the transport boundary; add_comment skips this idiom and is the only --json consumer doing raw passthrough
add_comment must normalize to either resource-shaped dict passed through verbatim or {id: None, acli_envelope: <envelope>} for batch envelope, with unrecognized shapes raising RuntimeError
other --json mutation wrappers (acli.update_issue, create_issue paths, update_priority, get_issue, get_comments) must be audited for the same raw-passthrough hazard
